page_title: HEI 2-3 HOF | Heidenheim v Hoffenheim 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Robert Hartmann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Omar Traore will be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
90+2' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
90+2' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Denis Thomalla did his best and is replaced by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).
90' 2 - 3 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) sends Kevin Muller the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
89' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
89' It’s a PENALTY to Hoffenheim after the VAR review!

88' Play continues despite the shouts by some Hoffenheim players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Robert Hartmann interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
88' A player from Heidenheim brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Hoffenheim are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
85' Omar Traore (Heidenheim) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
82' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) for a tough tackle.
81' 2 - 2 Goal! Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:2.
78' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) replacing Eren Dinkci.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin Pieringer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim).
77' 2 - 1 Spectacular goal! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
77' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
74' A substitution has been made. Ihlas Bebou goes off and Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) comes on.
74' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
73' The referee signals a corner kick to Heidenheim.
72' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
70' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
69' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' A lofted cross from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
67' A corner kick by Hoffenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Kevin Muller (Heidenheim).
64' Here is a change. Grischa Promel is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
64' The referee signals a substitution. Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Ozan Kabak.
63' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
60' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
58' 2 - 0 Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) makes himself enough space to connect with the resulting corner kick and produces a beautiful header which goes inside the left post.
58' Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' A cross into the box from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is cleared.
56' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
53' Substitution. John Anthony Brooks leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim).
52' We are about to witness a substitution. Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) is replacing Marius Bulter.

52' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort crashes against the crossbar and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!
51' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
50' A cross from a corner kick by Heidenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
48' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
47' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Omar Traore (Heidenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45+2' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The ball is out of play. Heidenheim win a corner kick.
42' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
40' The game is interrupted. Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
35' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
33' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
32' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
29' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
26' 1 - 0 Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
25' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Robert Hartmann changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
25' Celebrations by Heidenheim are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
25' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

25' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Heidenheim are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
22' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
19' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
18' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim).
16' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) executes a penalty kick, but only fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, right into the gloves of Oliver Baumann.
16' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is going to take the penalty!
15' The Heidenheim players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
14' Surely that's handball by one of the Hoffenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
12' Referee Robert Hartmann sees the trip by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Heidenheim have a free kick.
11' A cross by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

9' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Oliver Baumann to get hold of the ball.
8' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
5' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
4' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
2' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
2' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Robert Hartmann is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
